name: DiscountKit – Discount Rules for WooCommerce
author: Nazmun Sakib

sections.description:
DiscountKit is a WooCommerce discount rules plugin that helps store owners create, manage, and control flexible pricing rules directly from the WordPress admin.

With DiscountKit, you can create product discounts, cart discounts, bulk pricing rules, and quantity-based pricing using a clear rule-based system. You can target specific products or product categories, exclude products or categories, choose how discounts are calculated, and control rule evaluation with priority settings.

DiscountKit is designed for WooCommerce stores that need more flexible pricing and discount control without unnecessary complexity.

Whether you want to offer a percentage discount on selected products, subtract a fixed amount from eligible prices, create quantity-based bulk pricing, or apply a discount to a cart subtotal, DiscountKit provides a centralized way to manage your WooCommerce discount rules.

WooCommerce Discount Rules

WooCommerce discount rules are pricing conditions that determine when and how a discount should be applied.

DiscountKit lets you create multiple discount rules and configure each rule according to your store’s pricing requirements.

You can create rules for:

  • Specific WooCommerce products
  • Product categories
  • Cart subtotals
  • Product quantities
  • Bulk pricing tiers
  • Promotional pricing
  • Dynamic pricing conditions

Each rule can be configured independently, allowing you to manage different pricing strategies from one WooCommerce administration area.

WooCommerce Dynamic Pricing

DiscountKit provides a rule-based approach to WooCommerce dynamic pricing.

Instead of manually changing product prices whenever you want to run a promotion, you can create pricing rules that determine how eligible products or carts should be discounted.

Dynamic pricing rules can be configured using product and category targeting, discount calculation methods, quantity conditions, and rule priorities.

This makes DiscountKit useful for stores that need pricing to change according to predefined conditions.

WooCommerce Bulk Pricing

DiscountKit includes a Bulk Discount rule type for creating quantity-based pricing tiers.

For example, a store can configure different prices for different quantity ranges:

  • 1–5 items: standard pricing
  • 6–10 items: discounted pricing
  • 11–20 items: lower pricing

Bulk pricing can be configured using fixed prices for quantity tiers.

DiscountKit can apply bulk discounts based on individual product quantity or combined quantities across matching products.

WooCommerce Quantity Discounts

Quantity discounts allow stores to offer different pricing when customers purchase products in larger quantities.

With DiscountKit, you can create bulk discount rules based on quantity ranges and configure the pricing for each tier.

This can be useful for stores selling products in volume or offering better pricing for larger purchases.

Product Discounts

Product Adjustment rules allow you to apply discounts directly to eligible products.

You can target specific products or use product categories to determine which products should receive a discount.

Product Adjustment rules support percentage and fixed amount discount calculations.

Cart Discounts

Cart Adjustment rules allow you to apply a discount to the cart subtotal.

This provides a way to create cart-level discount rules when the discount should be calculated against the customer’s cart rather than applied only to an individual product.

Product and Category Targeting

DiscountKit provides flexible targeting options for discount rules.

You can include or exclude specific products and categories.

Available targeting options include:

  • Include specific products
  • Exclude specific products
  • Include selected categories
  • Exclude selected categories
  • Combine multiple targeting conditions

This allows you to control which products are eligible for a particular discount rule.

For example, you can create a category discount while excluding selected products from that category.

Percentage Discounts

Percentage discounts reduce an eligible price by a specified percentage.

For example, you can configure a rule to provide a 10% discount on selected products.

Percentage discounts are available for supported DiscountKit rule types.

Fixed Amount Discounts

Fixed amount discounts subtract a specified amount from an eligible price.

For example, you can configure a rule to provide a $5 discount on eligible products.

This can be useful when you want a consistent monetary reduction instead of a percentage-based discount.

Fixed Price Bulk Discounts

Bulk Discount rules support fixed price calculations for quantity-based pricing tiers.

For example:

  • 1–5 units: regular pricing
  • 6–10 units: $20 per unit
  • 11–20 units: $18 per unit

This provides a simple way to create volume pricing for products purchased in larger quantities.

Regular Price and Sale Price

DiscountKit allows you to choose whether discount calculations should use the regular product price or the sale price.

This gives store owners more control over how discount rules interact with existing WooCommerce product pricing.

The selected price source can be configured from the DiscountKit settings.

Discount Rule Priority

A WooCommerce store may have multiple discount rules that could potentially apply to the same products or cart.

DiscountKit provides rule priority settings to help control evaluation order.

Rules with lower priority values are evaluated first.

This allows store owners to organize their discount rules and determine which rules should be evaluated before others.

Enable or Disable Discount Rules

Discount rules can be enabled or disabled without removing their configuration.

This is useful for temporary promotions, seasonal offers, marketing campaigns, and other pricing rules that may only need to run for a specific period.

Discount Usage Tracking

DiscountKit includes discount rule usage tracking so store owners can monitor how configured discount rules are being used.

This provides additional visibility when managing multiple pricing and discount rules.

WooCommerce-Native Administration

DiscountKit is designed to work within the familiar WordPress and WooCommerce administration experience.

After activation, DiscountKit can be configured from:

WooCommerce > DiscountKit

The dedicated administration area keeps discount rules and settings organized in one location.

Features

  • Create unlimited WooCommerce discount rules
  • Product-level discount rules
  • Cart-level discount rules
  • Bulk discount rules
  • WooCommerce dynamic pricing support
  • Quantity-based pricing tiers
  • Percentage discounts
  • Fixed amount discounts
  • Fixed price bulk pricing
  • Product include rules
  • Product exclude rules
  • Category include rules
  • Category exclude rules
  • Combined product and category targeting
  • Regular price discount calculation
  • Sale price discount calculation
  • Priority-based rule evaluation
  • Enable or disable individual rules
  • Discount rule usage tracking
  • WooCommerce-native administration
  • Global discount settings
  • Reset plugin settings to defaults

Rule Types

DiscountKit supports three primary rule types.

Product Adjustment

Product Adjustment rules apply discounts directly to eligible products.

Use Product Adjustment when you want to change the pricing of selected products or products within selected categories.

Product Adjustment rules support percentage and fixed amount discount calculations.

Cart Adjustment

Cart Adjustment rules apply a discount to the cart subtotal.

Use Cart Adjustment when you need a cart-level discount instead of changing the price of an individual product.

Bulk Discount

Bulk Discount rules create quantity-based pricing tiers.

Use Bulk Discount when customers should receive different pricing based on the quantity they purchase.

Bulk Discount supports fixed price tiers and can work with individual product quantities or combined quantities across matching products.

Discount Types

DiscountKit supports multiple discount calculation methods.

Percentage

Reduce the eligible price by a percentage value.

Example:

10% off eligible products.

Fixed Amount

Subtract a specific monetary amount from the eligible price.

Example:

$5 off an eligible product.

Fixed Price

Set a specific price for a bulk pricing tier.

Example:

10 or more units = $20 per unit.

Fixed Price is available for bulk discount configurations.

Product and Category Targeting

DiscountKit allows you to control which products are affected by each discount rule.

Include Products

Select specific products that should be eligible for a discount rule.

Exclude Products

Prevent selected products from receiving a discount rule.

Include Categories

Apply a discount rule to products belonging to selected WooCommerce categories.

Exclude Categories

Prevent products from selected categories from receiving a particular discount rule.

Using include and exclude conditions together provides more precise control over WooCommerce pricing rules.

Common WooCommerce Discount Use Cases

DiscountKit can be used for a variety of WooCommerce pricing and discount scenarios.

Product-Specific Discounts

Create a discount for selected products without changing pricing across the rest of your store.

Category Discounts

Apply discount rules to products belonging to selected WooCommerce categories.

Quantity Discounts

Offer different pricing when customers purchase larger quantities.

Bulk Pricing

Create quantity-based pricing tiers for products commonly purchased in volume.

Cart Discounts

Apply a discount to the cart subtotal using a Cart Adjustment rule.

Promotional Pricing

Create product, cart, or bulk pricing rules for promotional campaigns.

Dynamic Pricing

Use predefined pricing rules to change eligible product or cart pricing according to configured conditions.

Volume Pricing

Create different fixed prices for different quantity ranges.

How DiscountKit Works

DiscountKit uses a rule-based pricing workflow.

  1. Install and activate DiscountKit.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > DiscountKit.
  4. Create a new discount rule.
  5. Select the appropriate rule type.
  6. Choose the discount calculation method.
  7. Select products or categories to include or exclude.
  8. Configure the required pricing or quantity conditions.
  9. Set the rule priority when necessary.
  10. Enable the rule and test the resulting pricing.

This workflow provides a centralized way to manage WooCommerce discount rules and pricing conditions.

Why Use DiscountKit?

WooCommerce provides the foundation for ecommerce pricing, but many stores need additional rule-based pricing options for products, categories, quantities, and carts.

DiscountKit provides a focused solution for stores that need:

  • Flexible WooCommerce discount rules
  • Product pricing adjustments
  • Cart-level discounts
  • Bulk pricing
  • Quantity discounts
  • Dynamic pricing
  • Product targeting
  • Category targeting
  • Include and exclude conditions
  • Percentage discounts
  • Fixed amount discounts
  • Fixed price bulk tiers
  • Discount rule priorities
  • Discount usage tracking

Instead of manually changing prices for every promotion, store owners can create reusable discount rules and manage them from a dedicated WooCommerce interface.

Settings

DiscountKit includes settings for controlling general discount behavior.

Price Calculation Source

Choose whether discounts should be calculated using the regular product price or sale price.

Global Discount Behavior

Control global DiscountKit discount behavior from the plugin settings.

Reset Settings

Reset DiscountKit settings to their default values when necessary.

Compatibility

DiscountKit is designed to work with WordPress and WooCommerce.

Requirements:

  • WordPress 5.0 or later
  • WooCommerce
  • PHP 7.4 or later

Documentation and Support

For support, feature requests, bug reports, and development information, visit the DiscountKit project repository:

https://github.com/nazmunsakib/discountkit

When reporting an issue, include relevant information such as your WordPress version, WooCommerce version, PHP version, DiscountKit version, and the discount rule configuration involved.

Additional Information

DiscountKit is developed as a focused WooCommerce pricing and discount solution for store owners who need flexible rule-based pricing.

The plugin provides product adjustments, cart adjustments, bulk discount rules, quantity-based pricing, product and category targeting, multiple discount calculation methods, and priority-based rule evaluation.

For support, feature requests, bug reports, or development information, visit:

https://github.com/nazmunsakib/discountkit

Product and developer information:

https://nazmunsakib.com
sections.installation:
1. Install DiscountKit through the WordPress Plugins screen or upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/discountkit/ directory.
  2. Activate DiscountKit from the Plugins menu.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > DiscountKit.
  5. Create a discount rule.
  6. Configure the rule conditions and discount.
  7. Enable the rule.
  8. Test the resulting pricing on your storefront.
sections.faq:
What is DiscountKit?

DiscountKit is a WooCommerce discount rules plugin for creating product discounts, cart discounts, bulk pricing, quantity discounts, and dynamic pricing rules.

Does DiscountKit require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated for DiscountKit to function.

Can I create multiple WooCommerce discount rules?

Yes. DiscountKit allows you to create unlimited discount rules and assign priorities to control rule evaluation order.

What are WooCommerce discount rules?

WooCommerce discount rules are predefined pricing conditions that determine when and how a discount should be applied to eligible products or a cart. DiscountKit provides an interface for creating and managing these rules.

Can I create product discounts?

Yes. Product Adjustment rules allow you to apply percentage or fixed amount discounts to eligible products.

Can I create cart discounts?

Yes. Cart Adjustment rules allow you to apply discounts to the cart subtotal.

Can I create bulk pricing?

Yes. DiscountKit includes a Bulk Discount rule type for creating quantity-based pricing tiers.

Can I create quantity-based discounts?

Yes. Bulk Discount rules can be used to create different pricing based on quantity ranges.

How do bulk discounts work?

Bulk discounts allow you to create quantity-based pricing tiers. For example, you can configure one price for 1–5 items and a lower price for 6–10 items. DiscountKit supports bulk pricing based on individual product quantity or combined quantities across matching products.

What discount types does DiscountKit support?

DiscountKit supports Percentage, Fixed Amount, and Fixed Price calculations for bulk discount tiers.

What is the difference between Rule Type and Discount Type?

Rule Type determines where the rule applies:

  • Product Adjustment
  • Cart Adjustment
  • Bulk Discount

Discount Type determines how the discount is calculated:

  • Percentage
  • Fixed Amount
  • Fixed Price for bulk discount rules

Can I include specific products in a discount rule?

Yes. DiscountKit allows you to include specific products when configuring a discount rule.

Can I exclude products from a discount rule?

Yes. You can exclude specific products from discount rules.

Can I target WooCommerce product categories?

Yes. DiscountKit allows you to include or exclude WooCommerce product categories when configuring discount rules.

Can I exclude categories from a discount?

Yes. Selected categories can be excluded from a discount rule.

Can I calculate discounts from sale prices?

Yes. DiscountKit allows you to choose whether discount calculations use regular prices or sale prices.

What happens when multiple discount rules apply?

DiscountKit uses rule priority to determine evaluation order. Rules with lower priority values are evaluated first.

Can I disable a discount rule without deleting it?

Yes. Individual discount rules can be enabled or disabled as needed.

Can DiscountKit be used for promotional pricing?

Yes. DiscountKit can be used to create product, cart, and quantity-based pricing rules for promotional campaigns.

Can DiscountKit create volume pricing?

Yes. Bulk Discount rules can be used to create fixed-price tiers for different quantity ranges.

Where can I manage DiscountKit rules?

DiscountKit rules can be managed from WooCommerce > DiscountKit in the WordPress administration area.
